notes.title: CAT AWARENESS FELINE SALE 2025
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/40007110/9affafd22cbc636ccad8cd37d4491a84dbcd103f.png[/img]

Hello, everyone!

We are delighted to announce that our cat games are part of the [b]Cat Awareness Feline Sale 2025[/b] on Steam, organized by DevCats.

If you love and cherish your feline companions, this is a wonderful chance to support cat-loving creators who care with so much affection.

The event is already live and runs until September 18th. Don’t miss this opportunity to celebrate cats and discover amazing games from different studios!
👉 Check out our featured titles [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/59093/CatLogic_Pack/]here[/url].

And remember: all around the world, pets need love, care, and a home. Whenever you can, adopt and protect kittens (or other animals) in need. 💖

We thank [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/devcats]DevCats [/url] for hosting this special event and send all our love and support!

notes.title: Update! Collections, Achievements and New Levels
notes.content:
Hello, in this update, we’ve implemented significant changes and improvements.

After receiving several improvement suggestions from you, we decided to return to work on Mimi the Cat – Meow Together to provide a better experience. This update includes:

[b]15 New Levels[/b] – All handcrafted with care, ensuring challenges and fun! We also organized the level progression to make the evolution smoother and more satisfying.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531175/a7e1086af1762cd2aee48e56696047f76f1471f2.gif[/img]

[b]Steam Achievements[/b] – Now you can unlock achievements as you progress in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531175/329a7da9056f0d9acc86bf67c4483035de17c516.png[/img]

[b]New Outfits![/b] – Mimi and her friends are ready to show off their style! We added 5 new customization options, allowing you to create the perfect combination!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531175/ca488a40fb647bef74f903cef0d218d212c9ac4d.gif[/img]

[b]Critical bugs[/b] related to the trains have been fixed. If you encounter any issues, please report them in our Community Hub.

Follow our developer page on Steam to stay updated!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/WiseBoxStudios]Wise Box Studios[/url]

notes.title: Update: Achievements and New Outfits Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531175/59f620b70ffd4c69627b99d0a2372df97fbd8e5c.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

We want to let you know that we are currently working on implementing achievements for Mimi the Cat - Meow Together. Although the achievements are visible on the store page, they are not yet available in the game at the moment. We are dedicated to ensuring everything works perfectly before releasing them to you.

Additionally, we are working on new outfits for Mimi! A general update is on the way to bring these new features to the game.

We appreciate your patience and support as we continue to improve the game. Stay tuned for more updates soon!

Thank you!

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content:
We noticed an inconsistency in acquiring new cosmetic items. Some items were not collectible with a brief touch, such as how the controls for the Pupupu Express (toy train) work. As a result, the functionality of cosmetic items has been altered. Now, any contact will activate the item. This includes jumping from one platform to grab it.

Correction of the hint system in stage 16.

notes.title: Mimi the Cat - Meow Together now avaliable!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40007110/3902de0f01bd71a5b4a48a4135fa0210f4947482.png[/img]
Meow Together is Wise Box's first local cooperative game. We are very excited to bring this new experience to our players.

[b]O jogo já está disponível![/b]

Mimi the Cat - Meow Together is a sokoban-style game that can be played solo or in local cooperative mode. Create strategies by pushing, stacking, and jumping long distances so that the kittens reach their cozy beds and rest.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2509700/Mimi_the_Cat__Meow_Together/

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40007110/bcf30a018936726a32ece9d46509496d71b60f80.gif[/img]

There are 9 cats for you to choose from, with 13 different outfits.
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40007110/62c3690a6ae7a4d3458a038d4edefe1b12ae3683.gif[/img]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40007110/bccb4dda15939c04e35e1320245c196ed13e62db.gif[/img]
